verdict.rationale: Ironclad's documented Workflows API launches contract workflows from templates, singly or in bulk, with template IDs retrievable via API. Integrations can read and update the underlying contract documents. Signing can be embedded or routed through your own provider, with signed agreements collected via API. Caveats: workflows must first be designed and published in the no-code Workflow Designer, and API access requires a paid add-on. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of field-level population payloads and of programmatically triggering the send-for-signature step, a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of the API.
